download_dolly_dataset: download the Databricks Dolly 15K dataset and save it as a JSONL file
normalize_to_alpaca_format: normalize Dolly dataset fields from instruction context response to Alpaca format instruction input output
download_custom_url: download a dataset from a custom URL and save the normalized output to a JSONL file
run_download_dolly_cli: run the download_dolly CLI tool with an output path to fetch and save the Dolly 15K dataset
create_output_directory: automatically create parent directories when saving the downloaded Dolly dataset to a nested output path
